summary: feat(passkeys): add Glean events for passwordless Sync opt-in and wraps
description:
Because:

* Product needs to measure the passwordless Sync opt-in funnel, including declines, which nothing else records
* Wrap create and retrieve outcomes had security events but no Glean signal

This commit:

* Adds passkey.upgrade_prompt_* events to the opt-in page, tagged with the sign-in surface
* Carries the surface on PasskeyWrapData from the passkey sign-in to the opt-in page
* Adds passkey.wrap_create_success, wrap_retrieve_success and wrap_retrieve_error
* Skips wrap_retrieve_error when the passkey has no wrap stored
* Passes Glean into the passkey wrap routes

Closes #FXA-13266
